hygienic-physiology-with-special-referen: Joel Dorman Steele's textbook taught schoolchildren physiology with a strong temperance message — the evils of alcohol and narcotics backed by science. Part of the great nineteenth-century schoolbook empire, it shaped young minds and morals alike. A fascinating educational artifact.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FBIFOIARecordsG:
A letter from the U.S. Department of Justice went to Congressman Louis Stokes about the House Select Committee on Assassinations report. Stokes had chaired the committee, which reopened the Kennedy and King cases in the late 1970s. The department wrote to tell him the results of its own review of the committee's report.

Such letters close the loop between an inquiry and the department it examines. The committee had judged the Justice Department's earlier work, and now the department answered on paper. The letter preserves that official response, part of the long paper argument over how the assassinations were investigated.
doe-osti-3403174-autosac-automated-sampl: AutoSAC got VULCAN-automated, and this DOE text covers sample activation calculations. The pages detail the automated findings. The nuclear folks get their data. The calculation was activation. The data were nuclear. The VULCAN were samples. The calculation were automated.
